lines: It’s summer that stretches over us as we look up at the sky.
You love to paint, and I watched you.
I, who could not love even a single thing in this world,
find it endlessly mysterious.
Don’t take anything away.
Hey, why can you keep trying?
You must carry the same wound, right?
I’m still paying the price for having lived alone.
Your hand danced in front of your chest.
She says, “I’m not alone anymore.”
With my head bowed, I lost the words, staying as I was.
Just to convey.
I knew that was enough, but…
Why?
You laughed as the wind brushed your ear.
I wish my voice had at least some color.
Summer passes.
Because I have nothing I want to do.
I got through sudden rains, shouting, and everyday life.
I no longer desire misunderstandings or tailwinds.
How are dreams any different from money?
What changes when we live?
Someone, answer me.
As if to drown this voice.
This is the end; even words have withered.
To the point where there are no more excuses.
The trembling spark wants to vanish toward where it’s headed.
Just like that.
I feel I’d understand if emotions and memories disappeared.
Draw transparent tears.
Standing beyond those eyes.
Neither daily life nor relationships can break us.
Living through such days.
I want to talk to you with a voice of my favorite color.
Your hand danced in front of your chest.
Hey, it’s happiness to be understood.
Because it’s something you can’t notice even though it’s right here.
This is the heart—don’t let go even if it hurts.
We still haven’t lived true to ourselves, have we?
Memories and feelings are what make me.
How we’ll use our lives from now on,
is probably the same for us.
